page.layout: One page of text, one column; a marginal note "Vide Constitut. Imp." at the right beside the upper lines (ne-stitut. Imp.); a catchword-like Greek phrase at the foot of the last line is part of the text. Page number 45 at top.

main_text.p: super liberum fit, pro libidine falutis doctrinam contemnere aut exagitare: nemini fas fit, se-ipsum subducere, si veid faciat falsa doctrina ad-ductus, sive alia quavis petulantia ingenii. Qua de re in hunc ufq; diem veteru Christianorum Casarum edicta extant plurima, in quibus ne-mini omnino concedsum volunt, falsam doctri-nam aut quodlibet schisma a communione Chri-sti inducere, nemine quoq; impune abire per-mittunt, qui nomine Christi signatus, ab Eccle-siæ & Sacramentorum communione abstineat, damnat omnes velut apostatas, qui in hanc co-munione se non includant, ad nullos honores, honestaveve munera admittut. Et hæc edicta im-peratoria, ut maxime salutaria defendit D. Au-gustinus, & ex sacris literis comprobat, reges & quoslibet in eminentia constitutos, tu demum Domino in sua functione servire fideliter, cum ea quæ contra pietatem & Dei jufsum admit-tuntur, pio zelo prohibent & puniunt; porro ipsis præscribens, ut majorem rationem habeant spi-ritualis conjugii, quomodo anima suo sponso Christo in-violatam fidem servent, quam ut maritis uxores. Sub-jungit & hanc doctrinam, Defectionem hominum a Deo multo severius puniendam, quam hominum se invicem: & si contingat nonnullos deficere, non quie-scendum, donec in viam reducantur, Dominoq; re-concilientur. Hæc omnia a magistratu effectui si dentur, facit quod sui est officii. Ex adver-so sacra scriptura connumerat inter magna Reipub. mala & ἀπλήσιαι, quando nullus in Ifraele Iud. 21. 25.

page.notes: The Greek word at the end is printed as "ἀπαλίαι" in the scan; the marginal note at upper right reads "Vide Const. Imp." (partly show-through and cropped). Several words are unclear in the scan and may be misread.
